SELECT oi.order_info_id, oi.user_id, oi.order_status_id, op.name AS person_name, op.email AS person_email, op.phone AS person_phone,
oi2.product_id AS item_product_id, oi2.product_name AS item_product_name, oi2.quantity AS item_quantity, oi2.price_per_unit AS item_price_per_unit,
p.payment_id, p.order_info_id AS payment_order_info_id, p.payment_number, p.amount AS payment_amount, p.payment_method, p.created_at AS payment_created_at,
-- 환불 정보 추가 (NULL 가능) pr.product_refund_id, pr.refunded_amount, pr.reason AS refund_reason, pr.status AS refund_status, pr.requested_at AS refund_requested_at, pr.refunded_at AS refund_completed_at, pr.processed_by AS refund_processed_by
FROM order_info oi JOIN order_item oi2 ON oi.order_info_id = oi2.order_info_id JOIN order_person op ON oi.order_info_id = op.order_info_id JOIN payment p ON oi.order_info_id = p.order_info_id LEFT JOIN product_refund pr ON p.payment_id = pr.payment_id WHERE oi.order_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND oi.user_id=#{user_id} ORDER BY oi.order_info_id DESC, p.created_at DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT
-- 창고 wh.name AS name, wh.location AS location,
-- 각 창고에 대한 각 보관함의 실제 출고 정보 shi.Shipment_Item_id AS shipmentItemId, shi.inventory_id AS inventoryId, shi.lot_no AS lotNo, shi.product_id AS productId, shi.quantity AS quantity,
-- 항목별 정보 oi.order_item_id AS orderItemId
FROM order_info AS oif
INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM order_item WHERE order_info_id =#{orderInfoId}) AS oi ON oif.order_info_id = oi.order_info_id
INNER JOIN shipment_item AS shi ON shi.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
INNER JOIN inventory AS iv ON shi.inventory_id = iv.inventory_id
INNER JOIN warehouse AS wh ON wh.warehouse_id = iv.warehouse_id;
